experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume_closeweighted
experiment.description: hf_patchtst_revin_no_volume (step 4) with a per-channel weighted RevIN MSE loss -- close upweighted to CLOSE_WEIGHT=4.0 relative to open/high/low (weight 1.0 each), since every trading-relevant quantity (take_profit, direction, coherence) is a function of predicted close alone. Everything else identical to step 4: patch_length=7, patch_stride=7, 20 epochs, flat LR=6e-4, no directional term, no schedule.

loss_weights.note: per-channel weighted MSE: open=1.0, high=1.0, low=1.0, close=CLOSE_WEIGHT
